baseline.weight_formula: For each of5 outputs: min(cap,N_train/(5*n_c)) if n_c>0 else0; train counts only; no further weight normalization
baseline.weighted_ce: CE with those train class weights; shuffle train only; N_train draws per epoch without replacement
baseline.balanced_sampler: K-balanced over K=N,S,V,F: WeightedRandomSampler replacement=true,num_samples=N_train each epoch; per-draw class probability Q=n_Q/N_train (natural frequency, expected n_Q draws per epoch), each K class (1-n_Q/N_train)/4 (expected (N_train-n_Q)/4 draws per epoch); per-sample weight=class probability/n_class; CE has NO class weights; never double balance. Replaces v3 per-sample weight 1/n_y over all5 classes, which gave the8 train Q beats about20% of draws while Q is not in K and validation has no Q (SV1 review of v3, item3a). Weighted CE of C0-C3 unchanged
baseline.seeding: At each attempt seed Python,NumPy,torch and CUDA with slot seed; deterministic algorithms,CUBLAS4096:8,cuDNN deterministic,no benchmark. Data generator seed=slot_seed+epoch-1, including sampler; retry identical seed/config/runtime
baseline.validation: Full fixed ordered DS1 validation,eval/no dropout,no sampler; all5 outputs; fixed K=N,S,V,F; unweighted CE descriptive only

early_stopping.rule: strict raw improvement resets patience; independent of rounded checkpoint ties

baseline.rounding_for_selection_only: Decimal(str(raw_float)).quantize(0.0001,ROUND_HALF_UP); equal quantized values tie. Store and report raw values; gates,mean/SD,scheduler and early stopping use unrounded values
baseline.checkpoint: Maximum rounded4 validation macro-F1 among epochs1..40; ties earliest epoch
baseline.deployment_seed: For EACH configuration, choose best rounded4 checkpoint macro-F1 seed; ties smaller numeric seed; THEN apply gates; no switch to another seed to rescue failing configuration

gates.uses: unrounded whole validation at selected deployment seed; report all3 seed gates
gates.gate_types: N and V blocking; S soft (v1.2 section4.2(c)): failure only requires disclosure in reports, no authority exception

baseline.configuration_selection: Exclude configurations whose best seed fails N or V. If any remaining configuration passes S, restrict pool to N/V/S configurations. Then choose highest rounded4 mean raw macro-F1 over all3 seed checkpoints; ties smaller C index. If none passes S choose highest mean among N/V and disclose S failure. If no N/V configuration STOP/report group and teacher; no grid expansion
baseline.statistics: Every seed,checkpoint epoch,raw metrics and gates; mean of all3 raw scores and sample SD ddof1 per configuration; failed/missing seed => mean/SD null and configuration ineligible, never mean2
baseline.retry: Technical NaN/OOM/crash/nonzero or missing summary: same slot/seed/config once, max2 attempts; retain both immutable attempt directories,logs,history/checkpoint hashes and ledger; no seed substitution

code_fault.rule: If the first slot ends FAILED_TECHNICAL after exhausting the retry rule (2 attempts) and no attempt wrote epoch-001.json (no validation result exists), the runner halts the whole grid with HALTED_PRE_VALIDATION_CODE_FAULT and does not start the remaining17 slots
code_fault.after_halt: Diagnose. If caused by a code bug: fix code as a new plan version (new plan SHA, diff reviewed) and rerun all18 slots from the start; not counted as a failed configuration; halted attempts retained and never used for selection
code_fault.scope: Only the first slot before any validation result; every later failure follows the retry rule and FAILED_TECHNICAL statistics
code_fault.random_data_smoke: Smoke on random synthetic data that never reads MITDB, to check file writing and checkpoint reload, is permitted; it yields no selection information and is not counted as training. Not written or run in this round

baseline.training_outputs: Ignored ml/data only; unique grid/slot/attempt directories; per-epoch history and improvement checkpoints; selected reload validation,summary,18 terminal slot ledger; no test loader
baseline.permission: Preparing/checking candidate does not authorize fit. Future run requires external owner M1/baseline lock and train authorization binding exact protocol and plan hashes; this round creates neither

nopeek.initialization: all seeds/runs start from SAME deployment A checkpoint; epoch0 must reproduce A validation metrics
nopeek.utility: EVERY_SEED macro-F1>=0.95*A deployment validation macro-F1; no collapsed selected checkpoint in any seed
nopeek.collapse: At selected checkpoint after reload:any class>=99% predictions OR SeV<0.10; retain numbers in statistics,lambda ineligible if any collapsed seed
nopeek.epoch_selection: lambda0:max macro-F1 including epoch0; positive lambda fixed epoch count,select min dCor among epochs>=1 passing utility; none passes => max macro-F1 among epochs>=1,fallback utilityfail,not epoch0
nopeek.lambda_selection: Among complete3seed,all-seed utility and noncollapsed candidates minimize mean fixed-subset dCor; tie smallerlambda
nopeek.deployment_seed: Seed with median raw dCor among3 selected seed checkpoints; if multiple equal median choose smaller numeric seed
nopeek.statistics: all seed values,mean and sampleSD ddof1; collapsed retained; technical same-seed retryonce; missing seed means no2seed mean

quantization.DS2_failure: Investigate first. Call pipeline fault only with evidence; technical repair retains prior artifacts/logs and reruns full compiled-scope evaluation. No choosing new calibration,finetune or hyperparameters from DS2
